original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

existing_checks.scope: Packing-independent ceiling for the selected paid profile under the one-unpaid-coordinate coverage and halving guard.
existing_checks.remaining: A changed word or model requires new pricing; a local packing search must name uncovered scope.

actual_scope: Attain both sharp pooled T16 profiles on the selected windows with distinct physical families per call and active-pair exclusion.
scope_change_reason: The live PR3395 handoff omits distinct-family feasibility; solve that specific missing implication instead of repeating local augmentation searches.
bottleneck_link: Closes the finite hosting optimum below the remaining physical admission costs; a new supplier or kappa still requires complete chart/controller/invoice checks.
stop_rule: Stop after exact flow acceptance, explicit owner reconstruction, inherited owner audit and separate pooled continuum proof replay, then publish one scoped result. Do not start physical optimization or another batch.
evidence: PROOF.md; CERTIFICATE.json; RESULT.json; DEPENDENCIES.json; registered three-command replay.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Tool authorship attribution is omitted under the donor instructions.

open_questions.question: Can either finite optimum pass complete native/controller/chart and stock admission?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Finite owner validity alone does not establish a usable supplier or exponent improvement.
open_questions.first_step: Export one nomination, derive its PLAN/SPEC bindings, and run the strict actual-chart/controller invoice.
open_questions.blocked_by: Physical cost/admission not attempted in this contribution.

open_questions.question: If an invoice fails, what extra constraint captures that exact charge in pattern-flow feasibility?
open_questions.why_it_matters: An exact finite optimum can still be physically unaffordable.
open_questions.first_step: Use the first rejecting chart or stock entry to formulate a bounded constraint and full ledger.
open_questions.blocked_by: Requires the first complete admission result and an expansion decision.
